texts: doha on life being a bubble that pops fast, use a date palm in it, so use the time wisely
The date palm sways a hundred years in legend, but a human life is a bubble on water, bright one moment and gone the next
Write me a Kabir-like doha where a date palm stands tall and a dream fades at waking, showing that life is brief and unreal, and that I should spend it wisely before it vanishes
my grandfather planted a date palm the year I was born, and now I am forty and it feels like those years went by in one afternoon nap
date palm, bubble, brief life
life is brief
hey doha pls: life is so short and unreal, use it wisely
Kabir often said that this life is unreal and passing, so please write a doha that reminds me to use my brief days wisely before they are over, and not to be fooled by their apparent length
A breath, a blink, a story half told: so quickly the whole of life is read and the page is turned
My daughter was a baby on my lap yesterday and today she is leaving for college; I do not know where the years vanished, and I want to spend what is left more carefully
Life drifts like a cloud across a summer sky, so lovely and so brief, gone before the thirsty field can even look up
can you do a doha on how life is a cloud, just passing by, so make good use of it

Please write a Kabir-style doha that compares this brief life to a cloud which gathers and disperses in a single afternoon, and which advises us to use the time we have for something worthwhile and lasting
cloud, brief life
We lay on the roof watching a cloud change shape and drift off, and my son said life must be like that, and I could not argue; now I want a doha about making use of the little we have
hey pls make a doha about life being a dream that ends when u wake, with a tree
Under the great tree we sit and dream the whole of life, and the dream ends quietly with the first bird at dawn
Write a doha in the style of Kabir about a tree under which a man dreams of wealth and fame, only to wake and find that the whole life was as unreal as a dream and over in a moment
tree, dream, brief life
I sat under the old tree at my school after twenty years and could not believe how quickly all that time had gone; it felt unreal, like something I imagined while sleeping
Please write a doha in which a fly buzzes through one short day and dies before the evening, as an image of how fleeting and unreal our own span is, and how we must use it to find something real
The fly rises with the morning and falls before the dusk, and a human life, long as it seems, is only a longer day
fly, brief life
A fly was stuck on the window all morning and by the time I looked again it had stopped, and I thought of how little time any of us really get; can you make a doha
doha pls about a fly and how life is so short and unreal
doha on a bitter gourd and how life flies by like a dream, please
Write a doha that shows the bitter gourd vine growing and fruiting and withering all in a single season, to remind us that life is brief and unreal, and that it must be spent wisely before it is over
The bitter gourd ripens and withers within a season, and so passes the dream we call a long life
My mother's bitter gourd vine sprouted, flowered and died in the space of one summer, and it made me think how the summer of my own life is going by
bitter gourd, brief life
Please write a Kabir-like doha about a cuckoo singing on a mountain that will outlast her, with the song fading into the valley, to show that human life too is brief and unreal like an echo
The cuckoo sings on the mountain and the song is gone before the echo returns; so is the dream of years we call a life
cuckoo, mountain, brief life
We climbed the mountain where a cuckoo was calling and my father said that our whole lives are shorter than that mountain's morning; he was right, so write me a doha for it
doha with a cuckoo and a mountain, about life being brief like a dream
Write a doha about weighing a life on the scales and finding it light as a breath, because life is brief and unreal like a dream, and the wise person uses these few days wisely
On the scales of the world, a life weighs no more than a bubble, and is gone before the measure can be read
My uncle took his scales to the bazaar each morning and in the evening it all seemed like the same day repeated; forty years and I cannot tell where they went. Please make a doha for that feeling
scales, brief life
doha pls with scales, how life is a dream that ends fast
Like a bubble on water, like a vapor in the morning air, so is this life that we fondly call ours
Please write a doha in the voice of Kabir that says this life is as short-lived and unreal as a bubble, appearing and bursting in an instant, so the wise person should not waste a single day on pride
doha about life being a bubble that bursts, plz
bubble life
My kids are suddenly teenagers and I look at their baby photos and feel the years went by like a dream I woke from too fast
A beggar slept beside the bus stop in the rain, and in the morning he was gone; it reminded me how unreal and brief everything seems, even the big things we cling to
beggar doha pls, about how life is a short dream
Write a doha where a beggar dreams he is a king and wakes to find he is only a beggar again, showing that life is a brief dream, and that we should use it wisely because it ends soon
The beggar dreams of a crown, the king dreams of rest, and both are woken by the same dawn
beggar, dream, brief life
My grandfather coiled the rope he used for his wisely each morning, and I remember it as if it was yesterday, though he has been gone twenty years; life seems such a short passing story
Please write a Kabir-style doha about a rope hanging in the courtyard that was new when I was a child and is frayed now, and let it show how brief and dreamlike a lifetime is when seen from the end
The rope is new in the morning and frayed by evening, and our days are only the length it takes to unwind
rope, brief life
doha with a rope in it, about how short life is, pls
cleric, brief life
Write a doha in which the learned cleric tells the crowd that life is as unreal as a bubble, but he himself is lost in comfort, so the verse should remind everyone to use their brief days wisely
The cleric preaches that life is a bubble on water, and the bubble listens, and bursts
doha about a cleric who says life is a dream that ends soon
Our local cleric died last month at seventy and just last year he said life passes in a blink; I want a doha reminding me to use what is left

Kabir used simple sweet things to speak of impermanence, so please write a doha about jaggery that dissolves in the mouth, just like this brief and dream-like life, which must be tasted wisely before it is gone
doha on jaggery melting away like life does, pls
jaggery, brief life
My grandmother gave me jaggery every evening when I was small and I can still taste it, though she is long gone and I am an old man; the years vanish like a dream
Jaggery melts in the mouth and the sweetness is gone before it is known; so is the dream of our days
I watched the fish in my uncle's pond shimmer and vanish into the depths and it struck me how a whole lifetime is like that glimmer, here and unreal, then gone
The fish flashes silver and vanishes, and the bubble where it rose is the only proof that anything was there
Please write a doha in which a fish gleams for a moment in the water and is gone, to show that a human life is brief and dreamlike, and that it should be used with care and attention
fish, bubble, brief life
doha with a fish about how life is like a dream and ends quick
palanquin, fire, brief life
My aunt's wedding palanquin and the evening fire seemed to belong to the same night, and now it is all gone like a dream; I am fifty and cannot say where the years went
The bride's palanquin sways by the light of the fire, and the festival ends before the dream is told
doha with a palanquin and a fire, how life flashes past like a dream
Write a doha about a palanquin carried through a night lit by fire, the music brief and the guests few, to show that this life is only a passing, unreal procession which must be used before it ends
Please write a doha in which a cloth sheet is spread and a fish swims by, over just one night, to show the brief and dreamlike nature of life, and to urge a person to use their time sensibly
I spread a cloth sheet on the shore to watch a fish being sold one morning, and by noon the seller had packed up; life seems that quick, a dream half remembered
doha with a cloth sheet and a fish, about how short and unreal life is
The fish gleams once on the cloth sheet and is still, and the morning's bright dream ends where it began
cloth sheet, fish, bubble
shadow, brief life
can u make a doha on life being a shadow that is gone soon
My shadow stretched long across the courtyard at evening, and then the light fell and it vanished, and I could not stop thinking about how I have used my years; make a doha for me
Write a Kabir-style doha where a shadow stretches across the ground in the afternoon and disappears at dusk, showing that this life is unreal and brief, and that we must use it wisely while it lasts
The shadow of a passing hour falls on the wall of the day, and the wall remembers nothing
doha on life being a short dream, and use it wisely
The dream of the long night is told in a single breath, and the morning has no memory of it
Please write a doha in the manner of Kabir saying that all that we think so solid and lasting in this life is unreal and short-lived, and that the wise person spends these few days on what is true
My father always said that when he looked back his life seemed like one long afternoon that was over before he noticed, and now I feel it too
dream-like days
Write a doha that says life is a bubble which swells and bursts so quickly that most people hardly notice they have lived, and that tells us to use our days wisely while the bubble holds
My son blew soap bubbles on the porch and each one burst before he could catch it, and I thought of my own years; please write a doha about using what is left
doha about life like a bubble and use it wisely
Brief as a bubble, light as a sigh, the years rise and burst before the child can call them his
bubble, dream, brief days
thief, philosopher's stone, brief life
The thief steals what he can before the dream breaks, the seeker chases the philosopher's stone, and both are woken by the same dawn
Write a doha in which a thief and a seeker of the philosopher's stone are both busy with their plans, while life, brief and unreal like a dream, ends for both before they know it
A thief broke into our neighbour's shop and then died in an accident a week later; my grandfather, who searched all his life for a philosopher's stone in old books, said life is that brief and unreal
doha pls: a thief, the philosopher's stone, and life being a short dream
Please write a doha about an arrow shot from a bow and a bee that hums for a morning, both showing how brief and unreal this life is, and how a person should use it wisely before it ends
The arrow flies and falls, the bee hums and sleeps, and so a dream of years goes past
A bee hummed round my face during the archery practice and my arrow missed the target; I laughed, and then thought how my whole life has passed like that, a quick miss and a quick hum
doha with an arrow and a bee about how short life is
arrow, bee, brief life
Write a doha in Kabir's voice saying this life is a dream seen in a short sleep, that the wealth, kin and fame in it are unreal, and that we should wake and use it wisely
The dream is told, the sleeper wakes, and the mansion of years is a handful of vapor
dream, brief life
doha on life being a dream we wake from too soon
The week my father retired he looked at me and said, where did it go, and I did not know what to say; make me a doha for him

Please write a doha about a philosopher's stone chased by a cleric through his whole life, who wakes in old age and finds that the philosopher's stone, like the life itself, was a brief and unreal dream
The cleric sought the philosopher's stone all his life, and found that the life was the vanishing thing
cleric, philosopher's stone, dream
doha pls with a cleric and a philosopher's stone and how fast life is
My great-uncle was a cleric who spent decades on the legend of the philosopher's stone and he died saying it felt like one short night; please make a doha for me
At the funeral of our cleric, a bee circled the flowers and everything felt unreal and so quick; I realised how little time I have to do something worthwhile
doha with a bee and a cleric about life being so short

Write a doha where a bee collects honey through a short day, while the cleric talks about the unreal and passing nature of life, showing that the bee uses the brief hours better than the preacher does
The bee gathers honey before the dusk, the cleric speaks of a dream, and both are gone with the evening
bee, cleric, brief life
Like the froth on the crest of a wave that is gone before it is named, so is the span we call a life
My childhood best friend and I met last week after thirty years, and we both said it felt like we had been apart for a weekend; the years are not real, they are a dream
doha on life being so short and unreal, please
dream, brief life
Kabir often said that this life is like a dream that disappears upon waking, so please compose a doha about how short it is, how unreal it seems, and how I should use it wisely to find what is real
lion, tree, brief life
The lion sleeps beneath the tree, the tree sheds its leaves, and both pass like a bubble on the surface of the days
doha with a lion and a tree about how short life is
We saw a lion in the zoo under a tree and the keeper said he was twenty, nearly old; I thought of how short life is for all of us, however mighty
Write a Kabir-style doha where a mighty lion rests under a great tree, yet both belong to a brief and unreal dream of the world, and a wise person uses his short time before it ends

Please write a doha in which a blind man walks through a bright day thinking it endless, and the day ends suddenly, as a symbol of how we pass through our brief and dreamlike lives unaware of their shortness
blind man, brief life
The blind man counts the days as endless, and the bubble of his years bursts with a tiny sound
doha with a blind man about life being so short and unreal
The blind man who used to sit outside our school passed away this week, and the whole street felt like a dream that ended too soon; I want a doha about that
doha on life being fleeting, so don't waste it
short life, unreal
I turned thirty this week and it felt like twenty years vanished while I was looking away; can you make a doha to remind me to use the time wisely
A day is a lifetime in miniature, born at dawn and dead by dusk, and no one weeps for it

Please write a doha in the voice of Kabir telling people that the world is a brief and unreal show, that they should not cling to its pleasures, but should spend their days in something truly worthwhile
The diamond glitters for one season of a lifetime, and the season itself is the bubble, bright and vanishing
a doha on a diamond and a bubble, life being short
diamond, bubble, brief life

Write a doha in which a diamond shines on a rich man's finger but his life is a bubble that bursts at the first touch, showing that all things pass quickly and unreal wealth should not occupy the mind
My aunt wore a diamond on her wedding day and she told me last week that the whole marriage felt like a single afternoon; I want a doha on that for her
On the weaver's loom the pattern is made in a moment and unmade by the weaver's last breath, a dream woven with a dream
weaver's loom, brief life
Please write a doha with a weaver's loom where the weaver works day and night as if he would live forever, but his work is an unreal dream and his hands must stop sooner than he thinks
My grandfather worked the weaver's loom until his hands could no longer hold the shuttle, and he said all of it felt like a short dream when he looked back; please make a doha for me
doha with a weaver's loom about life being a short dream
The thief and the moneylender both plan for years, but their years are a bubble that bursts on the same day
thief, moneylender, brief life
Write a doha about a thief and a moneylender who each believe their gains will last, and who find that life itself, unreal and brief, takes everything from both with the same quiet hand
doha with a thief and a moneylender about how short life is
The moneylender in our lane was robbed by a thief and died the next month of the shock; the whole thing felt like a dream, over in a flash, and I want a doha on that

Kabir loved the peacock's dance as an image of fleeting joy, so please write a doha where a peacock dances in the first monsoon, and the dance, like a brief and unreal life, must be enjoyed before it is over
I saw a peacock dancing at my friend's farm last year and she died this spring; it felt like the dance was over before I understood it, and I want a doha about this short life
The peacock dances before the monsoon, and the dance is over when the season has passed
doha with a peacock about how short and dreamlike life is
peacock, bubble, brief life
brief life
A morning, a noon, a dusk, and the whole of a life has been lived and lost
doha on how unreal and fast life is, please

Write a Kabir-style doha about how the world seems solid and long-lasting but is in truth an unreal and passing show, so that anyone reading it can be reminded to use the days wisely, rather than waste them
My brother and I were children playing cricket in the lane just the other day, and now we are both grandfathers; I do not know where the years went
The days pour through the hand like grains, and the grasp is a dream, and the dream is brief
Please compose a doha in which a person wakes from a long dream of status and family and finds only a short unreal moment, and then vows to spend his remaining days with a clear and attentive mind
doha about how life is just a quick dream, make it simple
life, brief dream
I woke from a nap this afternoon having dreamed an entire life, and felt a strange sadness that my waking life is no longer than that; please write a doha
Like the colors of a rainbow that fade before they are named, so do the days of a human life
doha on how fast life passes, don't waste it
brief, unreal life
Standing in my parents' empty room I thought that all those years were shorter than the summer I spent revising for exams; can you write a doha for me about it
Write a doha that describes how brief life is, how quickly the years pass for everyone, and how the unreal show of the world will be over before we have understood what we were meant to do in it
doha on how life is a short unreal dream, use it right
Hold the day lightly, as one holds a bubble in the palm, for the holding is the whole of its life
Please write a Kabir-style doha that tells us we are guests in a passing show that lasts only a few hours, that nothing we see in it is permanent, and that we must use our time for what is real
My colleague retired last week and she said she cannot remember the last thirty years clearly, as if it was all one long dream; I want a doha for her
life, passing show
My musk deer figurine and a block of jaggery were my grandfather's gifts when I was five, and now I am sixty; it all seems like one short dream that I have only just woken from
musk deer, jaggery, brief life

Write a doha in which the musk deer wanders the wilds searching for the scent that is within it, while jaggery melts in the afternoon, to show that this life is brief and unreal and must not be wasted
doha with a musk deer and jaggery about how short life is
The musk deer runs through the days chasing a scent that is his own, and the days dissolve like jaggery in the mouth
brief, dream-like life
It felt like only yesterday that I held my mother's hand to cross the road, and today I am helping her cross; the years vanished like a dream and I want to use the rest better
Please compose a doha that tells us how the years vanish like a dream upon waking, so that no one should think they have all the time in the world, and so that each day might be spent with care
doha on how life goes by like a dream, quick and unreal
The night is long only in the dream, and the dawn finds it a moment
doha on the moon and a short life like a dream
The moon waxes and wanes in a single month, and our years, bright and dim, are one such month in the sky of eternity
Write a doha in which the moon rises and sets in a single night, showing how swiftly life goes by, and let the verse urge the reader to use the brief hours for something that does not vanish
My friend and I watched the moon rise over her family farm, and now she lives abroad and all of that feels like another life, a short dream; can you write a doha about it
moon, dream, brief life
At the cremation ground the proud and the meek find that their long years were a bubble, shining and gone
doha at the cremation ground about life being short and a dream

Please write a doha set at the cremation ground where a mourner realises that all the plans and quarrels of the world were the content of a brief dream, and that the days left should be spent more purely
cremation ground, brief life
Standing at the cremation ground yesterday it hit me that my uncle's whole seventy years felt like a short film that ended suddenly; can you put this into a doha
lock, tortoise, brief life
Write a doha in which a tortoise moves slowly and a lock guards a treasure, but even the tortoise's long life is a short dream, and the treasure inside the lock is as unreal as the dream itself
doha with a lock and a tortoise about how life is a short dream
My grandfather kept a tortoise in the yard and a lock on his trunk, and when he passed I found nothing in the trunk but old letters; the whole life seemed like a short dream
The tortoise is slow and the lock is strong, but the bubble of a long life bursts in the same moment
doha about life being brief and unreal like a dream, use it wisely
Write a doha in the voice of Kabir that reminds us that this world is a gathering that disperses, that the years pass like a dream upon waking, and that the wise person acts wisely without delay
The dream was long in the dreaming and short in the telling, and the teller wakes with an empty hand
At my own birthday party I looked at the candles and thought that I have no clear memory of the last five years; they have gone like a dream, and I want to make better use of the next ones
brief life
Please write a doha about a moneylender who counts his coins as though the counting were forever, while life, brief and unreal like a dream, slips by in the next room and ends before he looks up
doha with a moneylender, about how short life is
Our moneylender was counting money one evening and the next morning the shutters were closed forever, and it seemed like the whole life was a dream; please write a doha for me
moneylender, brief life
The moneylender counts coins in the dusk, and the dusk counts the moneylender
The festival of the senses ends before the lamps are lit, and what we called a life was a single evening
plz write a doha on how life is a short unreal dream
Compose a Kabir-like doha which insists that the pleasures and griefs of this world are all unreal, passing shadows of a short dream, and that the wise person uses his days for something that remains
short, unreal life
When I was ten, summer seemed endless, and now I am fifty and an entire decade passes between two birthdays; I want a doha that reminds me to use what is left
Please write a doha in which a person drinks milk at dawn and thinks the day long, but by evening it is over, as a picture of how brief and dreamlike a life is and how to use it wisely
The milk is white at dawn and sour by dusk, and life is the same, sweet only while it lasts
My son drank his milk at the table and the next thing I knew he was packing for college; I want a doha on how swiftly life goes by
milk, brief life
doha with milk in it about life being short like a dream
well, bitter gourd, brief life
The water well fills by morning and empties by noon, the bitter gourd ripens and withers, and so does a dream called life
My grandmother drew water from the well and grew bitter gourd by the wall, and now both the well and the wall are gone; the years seem a short dream
Write a doha where a person draws water from the well each day, and the bitter gourd on the wall grows and dries, to show that the whole of life is a brief and unreal dream
doha with a well and a bitter gourd about how short life is
cleric, brief life
doha about a cleric who says life is a short dream, please
The cleric who taught us as children said our days would pass like a dream, and last week I realised he was right, as I looked at my own grey hair
The cleric folds his hands in the dusk and says that the day was a dream, and the dream agrees
Write a doha in which a wise cleric speaks of the unreal and fast passing nature of life, and a listener understands that even this lecture will be over soon, so he turns to use his days with care
doha about how life is just a short unreal dream, plz

Please write a Kabir-style doha that shows how the whole business of life, with its quarrels and its collecting, is a dream that lasts a few hours, and how the wise person wakes up and uses the remaining time wisely
The player bows, the curtain falls, and the long play of years was a moment in the theatre of the night
At my twentieth school reunion I realised that the years had passed like a dream, and the faces I knew were all grown old; make me a doha about it
life, brief dream
The bitter gourd hangs on the vine and withers, and a whole life of work is only the hanging
Write a doha where a bitter gourd and a dream both vanish at the first touch of the morning, to show how brief and unreal life is, and to remind the reader to use each day wisely
bitter gourd, bubble, brief life
doha with a bitter gourd about how short life is, please
I picked the last bitter gourd of my mother's vine and thought about how quickly her life flew by too, a short dream with a few bitter and a few sweet moments
The oil press turns and the palace stands, but both are the froth of a dream that ends at dawn
doha with an oil press and a palace about life being a short dream
oil press, palace, brief life
The old oil press in our village and the ruined palace on the hill were both alive when I was a child, and I see now how quickly it all vanished like a dream
Please write a doha in which the oil press grinds all day and the palace stands proud, but both belong to a brief and unreal dream, and the wise person spends his days on what is lasting
